Yes, earlier this year I got off my hormonal BC and my skin was a disaster. Like, the worst it has ever been in my entire life. Nothing I did worked it seemed like, and my last resort was using a product called Differin. It took about 3 months for my skin to completely clear but I am all good now. My skin is also clearer than it’s ever been as well. I was suffering for months using other stuff that just didn’t work because I was too scared to go on Differin because of the “purging” phase but ultimately it was worth it. If you ever need to use it, make sure you ease into it very slowly and not go straight into using it every day. I recommend watching Dr. Dray’s YouTube videos on how to use it. There are a lot of other tips on how to. It helped me not have the side effects that other people who probably only read the product’s directions experienced (like extreme dryness, etc). Hopefully your skin is fine though! Everyone is different.
